messages:
alec: Quick call for the 3-day mini: do we rollback the new reranker model that surfaced a precision regression for high-value queries, or do we ship the client-side latency micro-opt that trims ~30ms and reduces token churn? Need choice for the sprint board.

jess: Rollback. Precision regression is causing bad search results for two enterprise customers. We have an escalation in CS.

mona: Understand the severity, but the micro-opt unlocks cost savings and marginal latency wins across all tenants. If it's low-risk we could do both?

ravi: We measured the reranker drop to ~5% click conversion on certain predicates. That's material. Rollback buys time to re-evaluate the model.

sam: Can we dark-launch the micro-opt behind a flag and ship it? That one is isolated to client rendering and has no model-change risk.

jess: If we rollback, we should also backfill a short postmortem and a test that catches the predicate failure.

mona: If rollback is chosen, I still want the micro-opt moved to the top of Wave B. It has a clear ROI and quick dev path.

alec: Proposal: rollback reranker for affected tenant cohort now, add a regression test that covers the predicate, and dark-launch the micro-opt to 0% (feature flag ready) so its primed for a fast flip once reranker is stable. That lets us mitigate customer impact without losing track of the opt. 

ravi: I can own the rollback and add the failing-case unit test. Estimate: 4-6 hours to revert and run canary.

sam: I'll prepare the feature-flagged micro-opt PR and set it to off in prod. That way we can enable it for a small internal cohort tomorrow for sanity checks.

cs-bot: CS: Escalation recorded for tenant "Nexa Systems". Contact: sarah@nexa.com.

ops-bot: Canary rollback deploy queued: revert commit a1b2c3 for service reranker-svc to cluster shore-1.

jess: I'll draft the customer note saying "we observed degraded relevance for certain workloads and rolled back to restore baseline; we're investigating root cause; will follow up with timeline." Keep it short.

mona: Sounds good. I'll capture the micro-opt acceptance criteria and put it into Wave B with a soft-commit.

alec: Decision confirmed: rollback-first; micro-opt prepped behind flag. Action owners recap: Ravi -> rollback + regression test + canary; Sam -> PR with flag off + internal sanity cohort; Jess -> customer comms; Mona -> move micro-opt to Wave B with AC; Alec -> update roadmap board and postmortem tracker. Target: canary verification within 8h of rollback. Any objections?

ravi: No objections. Starting rollback now.

sam: PR up WIP, flag off.

ops-bot: Canary rollback started for commit revert-a1b2c3 on cluster shore-1. Monitoring channels enabled.

jess: I'll queue the customer note draft; will wait for canary green to send.

alec: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if canary shows anything unexpected. :thumbsup:
